title: Standard metabolic rate does not associate with age-at-maturity genotype in juvenile Atlantic salmon

claims.text: Metabolic scaling coefficient (slope of log10 SMR on log10 body mass) in the full mixed model (model 1)
claims.location: Appendix 2, Table A1(A), row 'Log10 body mass'. Results paragraph 2 rounds it to '0.88 ± 0.05 (95% CI)'
claims.notes: mod_rate1 (authors' script-Ash2021-4-models-mo2.R), lmerTest REML; term 'log10(weight)'; CI = profile confint(); p/F/DenDF = anova(type=3) Satterthwaite for 'log10(weight)'. N=150 (LL=76, EE=74; male=69, female=81; families=14; batches=10).

claims.text: No significant effect of vgll3 genotype (LL vs EE reference) on mass-adjusted log10 SMR in the full model
claims.statistic: fixed-effect estimate vgll3(LL); type III Satterthwaite F-test
claims.location: Appendix 2, Table A1(A), row 'vgll3 (LL)'. Results paragraph 2 says 'The vgll3 genotype had no significant effect on SMR (Figure 3)', and the Abstract states the same conclusion without numbers
claims.notes: mod_rate1 (authors' script-Ash2021-4-models-mo2.R), lmerTest REML; term 'geno_vgll3LL'; CI = profile confint(); p/F/DenDF = anova(type=3) Satterthwaite for 'geno_vgll3'. N=150 (LL=76, EE=74; male=69, female=81; families=14; batches=10). Type III F for the main effect is tested with sum-to-zero-type contrasts by lmerTest, so its p need not equal the t-test p of the treatment-coded coefficient.

claims.text: No significant vgll3 × sex interaction on mass-adjusted log10 SMR in the full model
claims.statistic: fixed-effect estimate vgll3(LL):sex(male); type III Satterthwaite F-test
claims.location: Appendix 2, Table A1(A), row 'vgll3(LL):Sex(male)'. Results paragraph 2 prints p = .69 for this interaction (conflict, see ambiguities)
claims.notes: mod_rate1 (authors' script-Ash2021-4-models-mo2.R), lmerTest REML; term 'geno_vgll3LL:sexmale'; CI = profile confint(); p/F/DenDF = anova(type=3) Satterthwaite for 'geno_vgll3:sex'. N=150 (LL=76, EE=74; male=69, female=81; families=14; batches=10). Coefficient t-test p = 0.1176. Paper prints p=.117 (Table A1) and p=.69 (Results text).

claims.text: Residual standard deviation of the full SMR model (basis for CV of residuals and the power analysis)
claims.location: Appendix 2, Table A1(A), Random effects row 'Residual'. Results paragraph 3 rounds it to '0.027'. Results paragraph 2 gives CV of residuals of 6.19% for the full model (6.23% for the simple model)
claims.notes: sigma(mod_rate1). CV of residuals = sigma*ln(10)*100 = 6.211% (paper: 6.19%). Simple model mod_rate3 sigma = 0.02708 (paper 0.0271). N=150 (LL=76, EE=74; male=69, female=81; families=14; batches=10)

claims.text: No effect of vgll3 genotype on body condition (Fulton's K) in the full condition model (model 2)
claims.statistic: fixed-effect estimate vgll3(LL); type III Satterthwaite F-test
claims.location: Appendix 2, Table A2(A), row 'vgll3 (LL)'. Results paragraph 1 gives 'p = .33'
claims.notes: mod_condition1 (authors' script-Ash2021-4-models-condition.R), REML; condition = weight/(length_standard/10)^3*100 as in code. p/F = anova(type=3) for geno_vgll3; coefficient t-test p = 0.5519. N=150.

claims.text: Post hoc power analysis: minimum vgll3 effect size on mass-adjusted (non-log) SMR detectable with 80% power
claims.statistic: simulated minimum detectable effect (power >= 0.8, alpha 0.05, 10000 simulations per grid point)
claims.location: Results paragraph 3 ('minimum effect size of 4.25% and 6% ... for the vgll3 and the vgll3:sex effects'), Discussion paragraph 1, Appendix 2 Figure A2
